title: Korean Southwest Presbytery — Citation regarding Assignment from GA/Review of Presbytery Records
disposition_detail: After Korean Southwest Presbytery responded to its BCO 40-5 citation, the SJC found that it had submitted its minutes and ordered them forwarded to the Committee on Review of Presbytery Records.
first_summary: Korean Southwest Presbytery was cited under BCO 40-5 for failing to submit its minutes. The SJC found that the minutes had since been submitted and said they would be forwarded to the Committee on Review of Presbytery Records.
summary: Cited under BCO 40-5 for failing to submit its minutes, Korean Southwest Presbytery responded and supplied them. The SJC found that the minutes had been submitted and directed that they be forwarded to the Committee on Review of Presbytery Records. The decision resolved the submission deficiency but left review of the minutes to that committee.

sources.supports: Case identity, collective adoption, BCO 40-5 citation, failure to submit minutes, subsequent submission, and forwarding to the records-review committee.

evidence_notes.identity_and_adoption: Lines 25–33 identify case 2010-22 and the collective SJC decision; lines 55–59 record adoption by a 20–0 vote with four absent (printed pp. 601–602).
evidence_notes.dispute: Lines 37 and 45 state that Korean Southwest Presbytery was cited under BCO 40-5 for failure to submit minutes (printed p. 602).
evidence_notes.outcomes_and_reasons: Lines 49 and 53 report the response, find that the minutes were submitted, and provide for forwarding them to the Committee on Review of Presbytery Records (printed p. 602).
evidence_notes.qualifications: Case 2010-22 concerned only failure to submit minutes; the acceptable-response ruling on exceptions of substance in line 51 applied to other presbyteries.
evidence_notes.incorporated_decisions: No decision was incorporated by reference.

source_limits: The source provides a short collective administrative decision and no additional reasoning concerning the contents of Korean Southwest Presbytery’s minutes.

score_reasons.concrete_dispute: Identifies the failure to submit minutes that prompted the citation.
score_reasons.decision: States both the finding of submission and the forwarding of the minutes.
score_reasons.decisive_reason: Explains that forwarding followed because the previously missing minutes had been submitted.
score_reasons.distinctive_value: Distinguishes resolution of the submission deficiency from the committee’s remaining records review.
score_reasons.fidelity: Does not attribute the separate exceptions-of-substance ruling to case 2010-22.
score_reasons.economy: Retains only the deficiency, response, disposition, and remaining review.

verification_notes: Rechecked lines 45, 51, and 53 to ensure that case 2010-22 was limited to missing minutes and was not included among the presbyteries whose responses to substantive exceptions were accepted. The final summary clarifies that committee review remained after submission.
